cohort: The study included all pregnant women, comparing those with symptoms and signs of obstetric cholestasis to those with no comorbid conditions.
finding: Women with obstetric cholestasis experienced significantly higher rates of preterm prelabour rupture of membrane, preterm delivery, prelabor rupture of membrane, emergency cesarean section, meconium stained amniotic fluid, and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was significantly more frequent in the obstetric cholestasis group compared to the control group.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy and around the time of birth, from January to December 2019.
